card_title: Spatial-TTT Adapts AI Models in Real Time to Understand 3D Spaces from Video
card_summary: A new AI system learns to track and remember 3D spatial details from long video streams by updating itself as it.

card_title: New Benchmark Reveals AI Agents Use Brute Force, Not Strategy, to Search.
card_summary: A study finds AI agents match humans in accuracy but rely on trial-and-error rather than smart planning.

card_title: IndexCache Speeds Up Sparse Attention by Reusing Indices Across Layers
card_summary: A new method cuts 75% of attention indexing work in large language models with almost no quality loss.

card_title: Video-Based Reward Model Judges If Computer-Using AI Agents Complete Tasks
card_summary: A new model watches screen recordings to check if AI agents completed user tasks, beating GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3.

card_title: DreamVideo-Omni Controls Multiple Characters and Motions in AI Video
card_summary: A new AI framework generates videos with precise control over multiple characters and their movements.
